features_verified: 1. GET /api/correction-hints?supplier_name=X returns only unambiguous corrections (no duplicates for same normalized_key)
2. GET /api/correction-hints returns empty array for unknown vendor
3. GET /api/correction-hints returns empty array for empty supplier_name
4. Edit dialog shows 'PREVIOUSLY CORRECTED' hints with per-field changes (Price, Total, Pack size, Name)
5. Each hint change has a 'Use' button that applies only that specific field value
6. 'Use' button for Price hint updates the unit_price input field
7. 'Use' button for Total hint updates the total input field
8. 'Dismiss' button on the hint box hides the entire hint for that item
9. Hints do NOT appear when current item values already match the correction
10. Hints do NOT appear for items without a _matchKey (e.g., new items or items without normalization)
11. Issue type badges (Math Mismatch, Pack Parse Failed, Missing Name) still display correctly
12. Fix All Issues button still works correctly
13. Correction memory still stores edits for pack_size, unit_price, total on save
